ledger.x: 13 July 1878: the Treaty of Berlin creates the autonomous province of Eastern Rumelia under Ottoman political and military jurisdiction (Article 13), with Plovdiv as capital.

13 July 1878: Eastern Rumelia "was created as an autonomous province within the Ottoman Empire by the Treaty of Berlin", "to remain under the political and military jurisdiction of the Ottoman Empire" with "significant administrative autonomy (Article 13)", under "a Christian Governor-General appointed by the Sublime…
9 October 1878: the Russian civil administration begins; the page does not call it an occupation, so the type is the researcher's reading.
18 May 1879: Aleksandar Bogoridi takes office as Governor-General and Stolypin's administration ends; the Organic Statute was adopted on 14 April 1879.

Eastern Rumelia "de facto ceased to exist in 1885, when it was united with the Principality of Bulgaria" (6 September 1885 O.S., 18 September new style); the Ottoman suzerainty stayed nominal to 1908 but the province itself no longer existed.
6 September 1885: "After a bloodless revolution... the province was annexed by the Principality of Bulgaria."
